name: Butt Hinge Assembly
description: Positioned multi-body item: a 60 mm five-knuckle butt hinge - two notched leaves meshing on a 10 mm barrel, opened 120 degrees, with a 5 mm pin through every knuckle - composed as a three-body Compound (no joints).

steps.instruction: Build the fixed hinge leaf with its three barrel knuckles.

transcript.user_prompt: Start a butt hinge assembly. Build the fixed leaf in its own frame, barrel axis on Z: a 3 mm thick plate reaching 30 mm out along +X over the full 60 mm hinge length, fused to the bottom, middle and top 12 mm knuckle bands of a 10 mm diameter barrel (bands 0-12, 24-36 and 48-60, shrunk 0.1 mm at shared edges). Notch the plate back to a 5.1 mm radius over the two mating bands, bore the 5 mm pin hole through the knuckles, and add two 5 mm screw holes through the plate at (13, 45) and (25, 15).
transcript.assistant_message: I built the fixed leaf: a 60 x 30 x 3 mm plate carrying the bottom, middle and top knuckles of the 10 mm barrel, notched around the two mating bands with 0.1 mm clearance, with the 5 mm pin bore through its knuckles and two 5 mm screw holes in the plate.

steps.instruction: Mesh the swinging leaf onto the barrel, opened 120 degrees.

transcript.user_prompt: Now add the swinging leaf as a second positioned body: the same plate-and-knuckle leaf but owning the two remaining barrel bands (12-24 and 36-48, shrunk 0.1 mm each side) and notched around the fixed leaf's three bands. Swing it open 120 degrees about the barrel axis so the two plates stand 120 degrees apart, and keep the leaves disjoint - 0.2 mm axial gaps between alternating knuckles. Return both leaves as a two-body compound.
transcript.assistant_message: I meshed the swinging leaf onto the barrel, owning the second and fourth knuckle bands, and swung it 120 degrees open about the pin axis. The alternating knuckles interleave with 0.2 mm axial gaps and the notches clear each other's bands, so the assembly is a compound of two disjoint leaves.

steps.instruction: Drop the hinge pin through all five knuckles, completing the three-body assembly.

transcript.user_prompt: Finally drop the hinge pin down the barrel as a third body: a 4.9 mm diameter pin (0.05 mm radial running clearance in the 5 mm bores) running the full 60 mm barrel and protruding 2 mm past each end, so it spans Z=-2 to Z=62 on the barrel axis. Keep all three parts disjoint, positions only, no joints.
transcript.assistant_message: I dropped the 64 mm pin down the barrel axis: at 4.9 mm diameter it floats through all five knuckle bores with 0.05 mm radial clearance and shows 2 mm proud at both ends. The hinge is now a three-body compound - fixed leaf, swinging leaf and pin - positioned but unconstrained.
